Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in
Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was heading east on a main road in Pasadena, in the right lane. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was
already stopping.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back
against the headrest.
Q: Did you hit your head on anything?
A: I don't think so, but my head hurt right away and I felt dizzy. I sat in the car for a few minutes before I got out.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They told me I have a concussion. I've had headaches,
trouble concentrating, and I get sensitive to light.
Q: Are you still under a doctor's care?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment next week, and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.
Q: Did anyone else get hurt?
A: No, my passenger was fine. The other driver was shaken up but I didn't see any injuries on their side.
Q: Did you take any photos of the vehicles or the scene?
A: Yes, I took a few on my phone before the tow truck arrived. I can send them to you.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Just that I'm having a hard time working right now because of the symptoms. I'd appreciate it if this could move
along as quickly as possible.
Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
